name: Aloo Paratha
steps: Knead wheat flour with water to make soft dough.
Boil and mash potatoes.
Mix mashed potatoes with chopped green chillies, coriander.
Add garam masala, amchur powder, and salt.
Take a portion of dough, roll into small circle.
Place potato filling in center.
Seal edges and flatten gently.
Roll into thick paratha.
Heat tawa on medium flame.
Cook paratha on both sides.
Apply ghee on both sides while cooking.
Serve hot with curd and pickle.

name: Kadhi Pakora
steps: Mix besan with curd to make smooth batter for kadhi.
Add turmeric and water, whisk well.
For pakoras, make thick besan batter with onions.
Deep fry pakoras until golden.
Boil the kadhi mixture on low heat, stirring continuously.
Heat ghee, temper fenugreek seeds, ginger.
Add tempering to boiling kadhi.
Add fried pakoras to kadhi.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve hot with rice.
